message.content:
- And in the beginning of this dark age, fire rained from the heavens
- Then came sons of man, wrought plagues of steel and poison
- Behold, two great wars descended, as locusts devouring all flesh
- And nations cried out, but the silence of heaven answered
- The atom was split, and the earth trembled before the new fire
- Famine walked beside the sick, and the frail were lost in memory
- Yet from the ash, voices rose, demanding justice for all
- The walls of empire crumbled, and the chains fell to dust
- And the sun of liberty shone upon every corner of the land
- So the century ended, weary but unbroken, as the stars watched on
